description.value: Dosa Factory is a South Indian restaurant on Kingsway specializing in over 100 varieties of dosa — fermented rice-and-lentil crepes served with house-made chutneys and sambar — alongside Indo-Chinese, North Indian, and Tandoori dishes. The 100+ seat dining room doubles as a party hall for large gatherings. The menu stands out for its breadth of vegetarian options and an explicitly gluten-free dosa lineup.
